origin: Original Quenderin contract from pinned upstream schema and producer facts; no implementation or fixture copied.

envelope.id: Nonempty opaque NUL-free string, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes; no Unicode normalization.
envelope.timestamp: Positive lexical unsigned integer at most 9007199254740991.

payload.unknownKeys: Accept and discard, matching upstream payload schemas.
payload.identities: connectionId and targetDeviceId use the same bound as envelope id.

binary.encoding: Canonical unpadded Base64URL. Decode with maintained platform library, then reencode and compare exactly.

limits.configured: Optional positive safe integers; clamp each independently to its own default; reject invalid values.
limits.decodeOrder: Bound input to 1 MiB before strict UTF-8/JSON parsing, then apply type-specific configured bound.
limits.encodeOrder: Validate typed input, serialize, measure complete UTF-8 output.

generation: Channel-supplied local metadata only; never encoded or accepted in the envelope.
intentionalHardening: Only handshake steps 1 and 2; upstream schema accepts any positive integer.
Safe-integer timestamp; upstream only requires a positive integer.
Reject duplicate keys and decimal/exponent integer spellings through the existing strict parser.
Canonical binary decoding is stricter than upstream permissive decoding.
Bounded NUL-free exact-UTF8 identities and decoded binary.
